newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Development Bank 96 net up 81 pct.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Development Bank 96 net up 81 pct.

text.p: Year ended December 31, 1996, (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 0.76 yuan vs 0.84 yuan
Net assets per share 2.45 yuan vs 3.78 yuan
Company name: Shenzhen Development Bank Co Ltd.
Note: The results, published in an annual report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Monday, were calculated under Chinese accounting standards.

The company, the only bank in China with a stock exchange listing, has proposed a five-for-10 bonus issue and a cash dividend 0.2 yuan per share, pending approval of shareholders at a meeting on May 26, the 1996 annual report said.
